verdict.rationale: LocalAI's homepage lists "vision" among the modalities its runtime supports, which is a first-party claim that it can run vision-language models. Beyond that one-line marketing mention, the pack has no documentation of how image-plus-text inference actually works. missing for 10: documentation of supported vision-language models or backends, an API example sending image input alongside text (e.g., OpenAI-style image content in chat completions), gallery or model-config guidance for multimodal models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
